en: 05 — Templates Message templates Ready-to-edit English templates for every situation. Copy, edit for the specific client, send. How to use these templates: Always edit the template for the specific client and their specific question — never send blindly Add the client's name where you see [Name] Fill in concrete details where you see square brackets [like this] If the template doesn't fully answer the client's question — extend it, don't force-fit Match the tone to what the client wrote — if they wrote one short sentence, your reply doesn't need to be a wall of text A. Incoming inquiries First contact, new clients, broad questions about treatments and prices. A1 Clarifying a broad inquiry Use when the client asks "what do you have" / "tell me about your services" without specifying. Hi [Name], thank you for reaching out to Cosmo Di! To help guide you to the right option — what are you mainly looking to address? For example: wrinkle relaxation (Botox), lip or face contouring with fillers, skin quality and hydration (biorevitalization), facial treatments, peels, body sculpting, or something else? Once I know your focus, I can share the relevant options and pricing, and we can find the right approach for you. A2 Replying with a price for a specific procedure Client knows what they want. Open Alteg.io for the exact price before sending. Hi [Name], happy to share. Our [procedure name] with Dr. Diana / our aesthetician starts from AED [price]. The procedure takes around [duration] and the result typically lasts [duration of effect]. Would you like me to find a slot for you this week? Mornings, afternoons, or evenings work better for you? A3 Sending full price list (when client insists) When the client wants to see everything before deciding. Never just dump a price list without context. Of course, [Name] — please find our pricing for [category] below. [paste relevant pricing] Please note: the final choice of product and protocol is always made by Dr. Diana during the consultation, based on your skin's specific condition and the result you'd like to achieve. This is what allows us to deliver natural, lasting results rather than a generic approach. Would you like me to book you in for a consultation so Dr. Diana can recommend the optimal plan for you? A4 Booking confirmation with reservation fee link Only when a reservation fee is required ( who pays ). Send right after reserving the booking in Alteg.io. If no fee is needed, send A4b instead. Wonderful, [Name] — I have reserved [day, date] at [time] with Dr. Diana / our aesthetician for your [procedure type]. To secure your appointment, we kindly ask for a time reservation of AED 210 via the link below. This amount is fully applied toward your treatment on the day – it simply holds your slot: https://buy.stripe.com/eVqfZie2J6eDfJ0d4j2sM02 Just a note on our policy: for changes made more than 24 hours before the visit, the reservation fee is transferred to your next visit or refunded on request. For changes within 24 hours, it is non-refundable. Looking forward to seeing you! A4b Booking confirmation without a fee – cancellation policy New client booked without a reservation fee: with the therapist, or with Dr. Diana when it isn't her first booking of the day. Always send. Hi [Name], you're booked in with [Dr. Diana / Fidana] on [Date] at [Time] for [Treatment]! 🤍 Please note our cancellation policy: appointments can be cancelled or rescheduled up to 24 hours in advance at no charge. For changes made with less than 24 hours' notice, a 210 AED reservation fee will be required to secure your next booking. We look forward to welcoming you! 🤍 A5 Booking a consultation For requests like "I have acne", "I want to look younger", "I don't know what I need". Present the free consultation as an offer. Check the consultation price in Alteg.io before sending (used only if the client won't do a procedure that day). Hi [Name], [concern] is exactly the kind of thing Dr. Diana works with regularly. The right first step here is a [Acne / VISIA / Procedure] Consultation — she'll examine your skin in detail, identify the underlying cause, and put together a personalised plan combining the right procedures and home care for your specific case. The consultation takes 30 minutes. And here's the best part: if you do any procedure on the same day, the consultation is completely free. Otherwise it's AED [price]. When works best for you — morning, afternoon, or evening? I'd be happy to find a couple of options. A6 Offering specific slots After the client tells you their preferred part of the day. Offer two specific slots optimal for Booking Discipline. Perfect, [Name]. I have [day] at [time] or [day] at [time] available. Which one works better for you? A7 First reply to an ad inquiry (concern-based) Client writes from an ad with a concern ("I want to treat acne", "I have pigmentation"). One reply: value + how it works + free consultation condition + scheduling. Logic in Section 4 . Hi [Name], yes — we'd be glad to help with [concern]. We use individually selected combined protocols designed to give you a strong and lasting result, rather than a one-off effect. It works like this: you come in for a consultation, and Dr. Diana builds a personal treatment plan for you. If you do any procedure on the day of the consultation, the consultation is free. What day and time would be most convenient for you? If the client won't do a procedure that day, the consultation is paid — check the current price in Alteg.io before quoting. B. Confirmations and follow-up Reminders (B1) and confirmations (B2) are sent by you from Revenelle: reminders every morning, confirmations as soon as a booking is created or changed. Revenelle prepares the text; B1 and B2 show what it should say. Then check who didn't reply (14:00 and 17:00) and message them with B3. B1 Reminder – from Revenelle, every morning You send it from Revenelle in the morning, for the upcoming appointments it shows. Hi [Name], a friendly reminder that we have you booked tomorrow, [day, date] at [time], for your [procedure] with Dr. Diana / our aesthetician. Could you please confirm that you'll be coming? Just a quick "yes" or "see you tomorrow" works. B2 Visit-day confirmation – from Revenelle You send it from Revenelle on the morning of the visit. Good morning, [Name]! Just confirming we're seeing you today at [time]. Looking forward to it — see you soon. B3 Follow-up to a non-responder (you send this) Send at the 14:00 check to anyone who didn't reply to the reminder. If still no reply at the 17:00 check – call. Hi [Name], just checking in — could you please confirm your visit tomorrow at [time]? We want to make sure everything is ready for you. C. Cancellation and rescheduling Handling requests to cancel or reschedule, with the first-time courtesy. C1 Cancellation within 24 hours — first-time exception Most important template. Acknowledge, state policy, offer courtesy, immediately ask about new date. Hi [Name], thank you for letting us know. According to our policy, deposits are unfortunately non-refundable for changes within 24 hours. As an exception for your first reschedule, we'll keep your deposit valid for the next 3 months — you can use it whenever it works best for you. Do you already have a date in mind, or shall we reach out a bit later? C2 Cancellation more than 24 hours in advance Standard rescheduling — deposit transfers automatically. Of course, [Name] — no problem at all. Your deposit will simply transfer to the new booking. When would you like to come in instead? Do you already have a preferred day, or shall I suggest a few options? C3 Reschedule confirmation Perfect, [Name] — I've moved your booking to [new day, date] at [time] with [specialist]. Your deposit is applied to this visit. I'll send you a reminder closer to the date. See you then! D. No-show and follow-up After a missed appointment, post-visit follow-up, Google review request. D1 After a no-show (1–2 days later) Send after no-show with no response to calls. Tone is warm, not reproachful. Hi [Name], we missed you on [day, date] and hope everything is well on your side. Would you like to find another time? I'd be happy to look at the schedule with you. D2 Follow-up 3 days after visit Sent in WhatsApp 3 days after the procedure. Genuine care, not a sales push. Hi [Name], hope you've been doing well after your visit on [day]! How are you feeling, and how is your skin settling? If anything has come up or you have any questions, please don't hesitate to let us know — we're here. D3 Google review request (in follow-up) Only use if the client didn't leave a review at the clinic. Combine with D2. [continuing from D2] If you have a moment and you're happy with your experience at Cosmo Di, a short Google review would mean the world to us — it really helps other women discover us. Here's the link: [Google review link] Thank you so much for being with us. E. Sleeping base reactivation Reaching out to clients who haven't been with us for 60+ days. Individual, not bulk. No offers — questions. Before sending — open the client card. Adjust each template to mention the specific procedure they had last, their preferences, anything personal you know. E1 60–90 days (warm) Reference their last procedure naturally. Focus is "how is your skin doing". Hi [Name], it's been about [X] weeks since your [procedure] with us, and we just wanted to check in — how is your skin feeling? Are you happy with how the result has been holding? If anything is on your mind, or if it feels like a good time to plan the next step, we'd love to hear from you. E2 90–180 days (mid) More space for the client to reflect. Open the door without pushing. Hi [Name], it's been a little while since we last saw you, and I wanted to reach out personally to ask — how have things been on the skin care side? Sometimes a few months after a [procedure type / treatment course], a gentle touch-up or refresh can really help maintain the result. If you'd like, Dr. Diana could take a look and suggest what makes sense at this stage — no pressure either way. Would it be helpful to chat about it? E3 180+ days (cold) Longer message. Sincere interest. Be open to "we're not coming back" as a valid answer. Hi [Name], it's been quite some time since we've heard from you, and I wanted to reach out — not to sell you anything, but genuinely to ask how you are. How is your skin feeling these days? Is there anything we could have done differently, or anything that didn't work for you last time? Whatever your answer, we'd really value hearing it. And if at any point you feel like coming back for a fresh assessment, Dr. Diana would be glad to see you. E4 Filling an open slot (proactive) When there's a gap in tomorrow's schedule and you want to invite a specific client to fill it. Hi [Name], a slot opened up tomorrow at [time] with Dr. Diana / our aesthetician — and you came to mind. If you've been thinking about [procedure / treatment], this could be a lovely opportunity. Would it work for you? F. Complaints and difficult situations Medical concerns, service issues, discount requests. Always human, never corporate. F1 Medical concern — transfer to nurse Client asks about a skin reaction, pain, or unexpected effect. Don't interpret — transfer. Hi [Name], thank you for letting us know — let's make sure this is taken care of right away. I'm passing your message to our nurse and to Dr. Diana — one of them will get back to you very shortly with guidance. In the meantime, please don't hesitate to share any photos or details that might help. F2 Service complaint — acknowledge and escalate Delay, confusion, anything client-experience related. Apologise sincerely, don't make excuses. [Name], I'm really sorry this happened — that's not the experience we want for you, and we take it seriously. Let me flag this to Tatiana / Dr. Diana directly so we can make this right for you. One of us will be in touch shortly. Again, thank you for telling us — it genuinely matters. F3 Discount request – when you decide not to give one Use this when a discount isn't justified (see the limits in Section 10 ). Acknowledge the request and explain the value. If the client asks for more than your limit, message the Clinic Manager. Hi [Name], thank you for asking. Our pricing reflects the level of care, the premium products we use, and the individual approach Dr. Diana takes with every client. For this reason, we generally don't offer discounts. What we can do is make sure the plan recommended for you is truly the most efficient one for your priorities — Dr. Diana is very mindful about that during consultation. Would it help to chat about which procedures would give you the most value? G. Objections Don't defend the price — explain the value. Don't argue — propose a next step. G1 " Expensive " I completely understand — and that's a fair thing to consider. Our pricing reflects the level of care, premium products, and individual approach Dr. Diana takes with every client. It's why our clients tend to come back and stay with us. The best way to see if it's right for you is a consultation — Dr. Diana will recommend the most efficient plan within your priorities, so you know exactly what you're investing in. Would you like to come in for that? G2 " I'll think about it " Of course, [Name] — take your time. Is there something specific you'd like to think over, or any information that would help you decide? In the meantime, would it be okay if I check in with you in a week or so? G3 " I have my own cosmetologist " Lovely to hear you have someone you trust — that matters. If ever you're curious about a specific procedure we offer (like Morpheus8, or our biorevitalization protocols, or our Wonder Axon body work), we'd be happy to share more, no pressure at all. In the meantime — we're here whenever you'd like to chat. G4 " Competitors are cheaper " Pricing varies a lot in Dubai depending on the protocols, the products, and the doctor's approach — so the headline price doesn't always tell the full story. What matters most is the result, and how it holds. If you'd like, Dr. Diana can do a Procedure Consultation, give you a clear plan, and you can decide from there whether the value works for you. Would you like to book that? Closing notes Phrases for closing conversations gracefully when the booking is confirmed or the client is taking time to decide. Z1 After booking confirmed All set, [Name] — we'll see you on [day] at [time]. If anything comes up before then, just let us know. Looking forward to it! Z2 When client is undecided Take your time, [Name]. Whenever you're ready, we're here — no rush at all. A note on tone These templates are written in a warm, premium tone. Every word is chosen — verbs like "wonderful", "lovely", "of course"; openings like "happy to share", "thank you for asking"; closings like "looking forward to it", "we're here". This is not call-centre English, and it's not casual texting either. It is the voice of a clinic that takes its clients seriously. If a template feels stiff for a particular client (some clients prefer very brief replies), soften it. If a template feels too casual (some clients are very formal), make it slightly more reserved. The templates are starting points — your judgement on the specific client is the final word.
ru: 05 — Шаблоны Шаблоны сообщений Готовые английские шаблоны для редактирования под клиента. Копировать, отредактировать под конкретного человека, отправить. Как пользоваться шаблонами: Всегда редактируй шаблон под конкретного клиента и его конкретный вопрос — никогда не отправляй вслепую Добавь имя клиента там, где видишь [Name] Заполни конкретные детали там, где квадратные скобки [вот так] Если шаблон не отвечает полностью на вопрос клиента — дописывай, не пытайся впихнуть как есть Подстраивай объём под стиль клиента — если он написал одно короткое сообщение, не нужно отвечать полотном A. Входящие запросы Первый контакт, новые клиенты, широкие вопросы о процедурах и ценах. A1 Уточнение по широкому запросу Используется, когда клиент пишет «что у вас есть» / «расскажите про услуги» без конкретики. Hi [Name], thank you for reaching out to Cosmo Di! To help guide you to the right option — what are you mainly looking to address? For example: wrinkle relaxation (Botox), lip or face contouring with fillers, skin quality and hydration (biorevitalization), facial treatments, peels, body sculpting, or something else? Once I know your focus, I can share the relevant options and pricing, and we can find the right approach for you. A2 Ответ с ценой на конкретную процедуру Клиент знает, что хочет. Открой Alteg.io для точной цены перед отправкой. Hi [Name], happy to share. Our [procedure name] with Dr. Diana / our aesthetician starts from AED [price]. The procedure takes around [duration] and the result typically lasts [duration of effect]. Would you like me to find a slot for you this week? Mornings, afternoons, or evenings work better for you? A3 Отправка полного прайса (когда клиент настаивает) Когда клиент хочет увидеть всё прежде чем решать. Никогда не вываливай прайс без контекста. Of course, [Name] — please find our pricing for [category] below. [paste relevant pricing] Please note: the final choice of product and protocol is always made by Dr. Diana during the consultation, based on your skin's specific condition and the result you'd like to achieve. This is what allows us to deliver natural, lasting results rather than a generic approach. Would you like me to book you in for a consultation so Dr. Diana can recommend the optimal plan for you? A4 Подтверждение записи со ссылкой на reservation fee Только когда reservation fee нужен ( кто платит ). Отправляй сразу после резервирования в Alteg.io. Если fee не нужен, отправляешь A4b. Wonderful, [Name] — I have reserved [day, date] at [time] with Dr. Diana / our aesthetician for your [procedure type]. To secure your appointment, we kindly ask for a time reservation of AED 210 via the link below. This amount is fully applied toward your treatment on the day – it simply holds your slot: https://buy.stripe.com/eVqfZie2J6eDfJ0d4j2sM02 Just a note on our policy: for changes made more than 24 hours before the visit, the reservation fee is transferred to your next visit or refunded on request. For changes within 24 hours, it is non-refundable. Looking forward to seeing you! A4b Подтверждение записи без fee – политика отмен Новый клиент записан без reservation fee: к терапевту или к Диане не первой записью дня. Отправлять всегда. Hi [Name], you're booked in with [Dr. Diana / Fidana] on [Date] at [Time] for [Treatment]! 🤍 Please note our cancellation policy: appointments can be cancelled or rescheduled up to 24 hours in advance at no charge. For changes made with less than 24 hours' notice, a 210 AED reservation fee will be required to secure your next booking. We look forward to welcoming you! 🤍 A5 Запись на консультацию Для запросов вроде «у меня акне», «я хочу омолодиться», «не знаю что мне нужно». Бесплатную консультацию подаём как оффер. Цену консультации посмотри в Alteg.io перед отправкой (нужна только если клиент не делает процедуру в этот день). Hi [Name], [concern] is exactly the kind of thing Dr. Diana works with regularly. The right first step here is a [Acne / VISIA / Procedure] Consultation — she'll examine your skin in detail, identify the underlying cause, and put together a personalised plan combining the right procedures and home care for your specific case. The consultation takes 30 minutes. And here's the best part: if you do any procedure on the same day, the consultation is completely free. Otherwise it's AED [price]. When works best for you — morning, afternoon, or evening? I'd be happy to find a couple of options. A6 Предложение конкретных слотов После того как клиент сказал предпочитаемую часть дня. Предложи два конкретных слота, оптимальных для Booking Discipline. Perfect, [Name]. I have [day] at [time] or [day] at [time] available. Which one works better for you? A7 Первый ответ на запрос с рекламы (по проблеме) Клиент пишет с рекламы с проблемой («хочу полечить акне», «у меня пигментация»). Один ответ: ценность + как это работает + условие бесплатной консультации + запись. Логика в разделе 4 . Hi [Name], yes — we'd be glad to help with [concern]. We use individually selected combined protocols designed to give you a strong and lasting result, rather than a one-off effect. It works like this: you come in for a consultation, and Dr. Diana builds a personal treatment plan for you. If you do any procedure on the day of the consultation, the consultation is free. What day and time would be most convenient for you? Если клиент не делает процедуру в тот же день, консультация платная — посмотри актуальную цену в Alteg.io перед тем как называть. B. Подтверждения и follow-up Напоминания (B1) и подтверждения (B2) отправляешь ты из Revenelle: напоминания каждое утро, подтверждения сразу, как только запись создана или изменена. Текст готовит Revenelle, B1 и B2 показывают, как он должен звучать. Потом проверяешь, кто не ответил (14:00 и 17:00), и пишешь им шаблоном B3. B1 Напоминание – из Revenelle, каждое утро Отправляешь утром из Revenelle по предстоящим записям, которые он показывает. Hi [Name], a friendly reminder that we have you booked tomorrow, [day, date] at [time], for your [procedure] with Dr. Diana / our aesthetician. Could you please confirm that you'll be coming? Just a quick "yes" or "see you tomorrow" works. B2 Подтверждение в день визита – из Revenelle Отправляешь из Revenelle утром в день визита. Good morning, [Name]! Just confirming we're seeing you today at [time]. Looking forward to it — see you soon. B3 Follow-up неответившему (отправляешь ты) Отправляешь на сверке в 14:00 тем, кто не ответил на напоминание. As an exception for your first reschedule, we'll keep your deposit valid for the next 3 months — you can use it whenever it works best for you. C3 Подтверждение переноса Perfect, [Name] — I've moved your booking to [new day, date] at [time] with [specialist]. Your deposit is applied to this visit. I'll send you a reminder closer to the date. See you then! D. No-show и follow-up После пропущенного визита, follow-up после посещения, запрос Google-отзыва. D1 После no-show (через 1–2 дня) Отправляется после no-show, когда клиент не ответил на звонки. Тон тёплый, не упрекающий. Hi [Name], we missed you on [day, date] and hope everything is well on your side. Would you like to find another time? I'd be happy to look at the schedule with you. D2 Follow-up через 3 дня Отправляется в WhatsApp через 3 дня после процедуры. Искренняя забота, не продажа. Hi [Name], hope you've been doing well after your visit on [day]! How are you feeling, and how is your skin settling? If anything has come up or you have any questions, please don't hesitate to let us know — we're here. D3 Запрос Google-отзыва (в follow-up) Использовать только если клиент не оставил отзыв в клинике. Объединяется с D2. [continuing from D2] If you have a moment and you're happy with your experience at Cosmo Di, a short Google review would mean the world to us — it really helps other women discover us. Here's the link: [Google review link] Thank you so much for being with us. E. Реактивация спящей базы Контакт с клиентами, которые не были у нас 60+ дней. Индивидуально, не массово. Не офферы — вопросы. Перед отправкой — открой карточку клиента. Подстрой каждый шаблон под конкретную процедуру, которую он делал, его предпочтения, что-то личное, что ты о нём знаешь. E1 60–90 дней (тёплый сегмент) Упоминаешь последнюю процедуру естественно. Фокус — «как ваша кожа». Hi [Name], it's been about [X] weeks since your [procedure] with us, and we just wanted to check in — how is your skin feeling? Are you happy with how the result has been holding? If anything is on your mind, or if it feels like a good time to plan the next step, we'd love to hear from you. E2 90–180 дней (средний) Больше пространства, чтобы клиент задумался. Hi [Name], it's been quite some time since we've heard from you, and I wanted to reach out — not to sell you anything, but genuinely to ask how you are. How is your skin feeling these days? Is there anything we could have done differently, or anything that didn't work for you last time? Whatever your answer, we'd really value hearing it. And if at any point you feel like coming back for a fresh assessment, Dr. Diana would be glad to see you. Hi [Name], a slot opened up tomorrow at [time] with Dr. Diana / our aesthetician — and you came to mind. If you've been thinking about [procedure / treatment], this could be a lovely opportunity. Would it work for you? F. Жалобы и сложные ситуации Медицинские вопросы, проблемы с сервисом, запросы скидок. Всегда по-человечески, не корпоративно. I'm passing your message to our nurse and to Dr. Diana — one of them will get back to you very shortly with guidance. Извинись искренне, не оправдывайся. [Name], I'm really sorry this happened — that's not the experience we want for you, and we take it seriously. Let me flag this to Tatiana / Dr. Diana directly so we can make this right for you. One of us will be in touch shortly. Again, thank you for telling us — it genuinely matters. F3 Запрос скидки – когда ты решаешь её не давать Используй, когда скидка не оправдана (лимиты – в разделе 10 ). Признай запрос и объясни ценность. Would you like to come in for that? G2 " Я подумаю " Of course, [Name] — take your time. Is there something specific you'd like to think over, or any information that would help you decide? In the meantime, would it be okay if I check in with you in a week or so? G3 " У меня есть свой косметолог " Lovely to hear you have someone you trust — that matters. If ever you're curious about a specific procedure we offer (like Morpheus8, or our biorevitalization protocols, or our Wonder Axon body work), we'd be happy to share more, no pressure at all. What matters most is the result, and how it holds. If you'd like, Dr. Diana can do a Procedure Consultation, give you a clear plan, and you can decide from there whether the value works for you. Would you like to book that? Закрывающие реплики Фразы для красивого закрытия разговора, когда запись подтверждена или клиент берёт время на решение. Z1 После подтверждения записи All set, [Name] — we'll see you on [day] at [time]. If anything comes up before then, just let us know. Looking forward to it! Z2 Когда клиент не определился Take your time, [Name]. Whenever you're ready, we're here — no rush at all. О тоне Эти шаблоны написаны в тёплом, премиум-тоне. Каждое слово подобрано — глаголы вроде «wonderful», «lovely», «of course»; открытия типа «happy to share», «thank you for asking»; закрытия типа «looking forward to it», «we're here». Это не call-центровый английский и не повседневный мессенджерский. Это голос клиники, которая серьёзно относится к своим клиентам. Если шаблон кажется слишком формальным для конкретного клиента (некоторые клиенты предпочитают очень короткие ответы) — смягчи. Если кажется слишком неформальным (некоторые клиенты очень официальны) — сделай чуть более сдержанным. Шаблоны — стартовые точки, твоё суждение о конкретном клиенте — последнее слово.

en: 06 — Processes Clinic processes Patient transfer between doctor and therapist, running the floor, consent forms, money, stock and invoices, and the deposit SOP. Your role in each. Patient transfer: doctor ↔ therapist The full document with five stages is maintained separately. Here is where your role fits in. Stage 1. First visit with the doctor Lock in the date of the patient's next visit with the doctor (the control checkpoint) If the patient reschedules — reschedule the control checkpoint accordingly Stage 2. Preparing the therapist Indirect. Make sure the correct procedure type is set in Alteg.io for the next visit (per the doctor's plan) so the therapist sees the context. Stage 3. Appointment with the therapist Meet the patient, update the status to "Arrived" in Alteg.io Coordinate with the therapist that the patient has arrived Ensure consent forms are ready (the nurse completes them with the client) Help the nurse with room preparation Stage 4. Doctor's checkpoint Book the patient in time for their checkpoint visit with the doctor — every 3–4 procedures, or per the course plan. Stage 5. Course completion This is your direct zone. 3–6 months after the course is completed — a thank-you message and proposal for a repeat course This is base work, planned and logged in the client card Message template — in Section 5 Running the floor: rooms, timing, delays You are the person who knows where everyone is. At any moment you should be able to say who is in which room, with which client, doing what, and when they will finish. In the morning go through the day in Alteg.io: which specialist, which room, which treatments, where numbing is needed and the nurse has to take the client first. Through the day keep track of when each room will be free. If a treatment is running over, ask the specialist for an updated finish time rather than guessing. If a client is late , you call and find out where they are. You don't wait. When a client arrives , change the status in Alteg.io and tell the specialist or the nurse straight away. Nobody in a treatment room can see reception. If the doctor is running late Tell the waiting client straight away, apologise and give a real time, not "shortly". Offer tea, coffee or water. Message the doctor for an updated time and keep the client informed until they go in. A client sitting without any news is what they remember about the visit. If the treatment needs numbing, ask the nurse to take the client in and start the cream, so the wait isn't wasted. If the delay is going to grow, move the schedule: contact the next clients before they leave home and offer a later time. Don't wait until they are sitting at reception. What to say I'm so sorry, [Name], Dr. Diana is running about 15 minutes behind. Can I bring you a coffee while you wait? I'll let you know as soon as she's ready. The full step-by-step for the arrival and the visit is in the client journey, stage 1 . Consent forms General consent At the start of the day look at today's schedule. For every new client (and anyone who hasn't visited in the last six months) prepare the general consent form and have it ready at reception. The client signs it on arrival, before the visit . Media consent Every client who hasn't signed it yet, new or returning. Check the card; if it isn't there, ask. If the client says no, record it in the card so nobody asks again. Treatment doesn't change, and photos for the medical record are still taken but never published. Media consent form → Bloggers and models Before any shoot or collaboration treatment, the matching consent form is signed. The forms are in the working documents folder . Treatment consent Prepared by the nurse for the specific treatment. Make sure it's signed before the client goes in. Signed forms are scanned and uploaded to the client card (see Section 7 ). Money: cash, petty cash and card payments You are responsible for all money that goes through reception: client cash, petty cash, card and online payments. Every payment is entered in Alteg.io with the right amount and the right method. The moment the client pays , the payment goes through in Alteg.io and into the current month's ACCOUNTING file. Not at the end of the day. Nobody takes money from reception without your control. Anything given free, for any reason, is recorded on the Complimentary Service Form and put through with a 100% discount. The end-of-day report to the finance group is described in Section 7 . Every petty cash expense has a receipt, the same day. Cash, petty cash and card payments are reconciled with Alteg.io at the end of every day. Totals are calculated in the system or on a calculator, never in your head, and checked before you take the payment. Discrepancies are your responsibility Any shortage in cash or petty cash, and any amount a client was undercharged, is covered by you in line with the clinic's policy and UAE labour law. If you undercharged a client by more than 200 AED , you can contact them, apologise and carefully ask them to pay the difference. Do it in a way that keeps the relationship: the client's loyalty matters more than the amount. If the client doesn't pay, the difference is covered by you. Message to the client Hi [Name], I hope you're feeling great after your visit. I've just noticed I made a mistake with your bill: [treatment] was charged at [amount] instead of [amount], so [difference] AED was missed. I'm really sorry about that. Would it be easier to settle it by payment link, or at your next visit? Stock, deliveries and invoices When something is delivered You receive every delivery of products and consumables that comes to the clinic. Check it against the order and the invoice. Register it in Alteg.io the same day. Take the invoice and upload it to the current month in the finance folder . Add it to the invoices tracker and keep track of what is paid and what isn't. Invoice payments Invoices are paid by Dr. Diana as the owner. This is the only non-medical question that goes to her. Your job is to keep track: send her the invoices that are due, and mark them as paid once they are. Showcase inventory – twice a month Count every product on the showcase and check expiry dates. Send the full report to the Clinic Manager and the financier. Send the Clinic Manager a separate list of items that are running low, to check and order. Orders are approved by the Clinic Manager. Supplier contacts are in the suppliers directory in the working documents folder . Deposit SOP (Reservation SOP) Full live document: Open the Reservation & Deposit SOP → Below are the key rules to know by heart. Reservation fee 210 AED – who pays Problem history (no-show in the last 3 months, 2+ late cancellations, 3+ cancellations in a row, a fee note in the card, no visits for 6 months) – fee required, with any specialist New client, clean history: with the therapist – no fee; with Dr. Diana – fee only if it's her first booking of the day; in the middle of the day or last – no fee. Without a fee, always send the cancellation-policy message Returning client, 3+ visits, clean history – no fee. Full decision tree on the booking page If multiple procedures / slots are booked as a course — 210 AED per slot (3 procedures = 630 AED) Payment via a Stripe link sent to the client right after the slot is agreed Payment window On booking Slot is reserved in Alteg.io immediately Within 24 hours Deposit must be paid by the client Next day at 12:00 Payment check. If not paid — send a reminder By 18:00 same day If deposit still not paid — the booking is deleted, slot freed The 24-hour rule (cancellation / reschedule) Changes more than 24 hours before the visit — deposit transfers automatically to the next booking Changes within 24 hours — the deposit is forfeited by policy First-time exception: the deposit is kept for 3 months (see Section 4 ) Deposit tracker A separate file (Cosmo_Di_Deposit_Tracker.xlsx). Columns: Date / Client / Service / Amount / Status / Used Against / Notes. For cancellations and reschedules specifically, log every case in the Cancellations & Reschedules tracker → Statuses: Active deposit paid, booking is live Used deposit applied to a completed procedure Forfeited deposit lost (within-24-hour cancellation, no-show) Refunded deposit returned (exceptional cases, only with management approval) Tracker is updated daily (at clinic close) and reviewed fully on Mondays (see Section 7 ).
ru: 06 — Процессы Процессы клиники Передача пациента между врачом и терапистом, координация в клинике, формы согласия, деньги, товар и инвойсы, СОП по депозитам. Твоя роль в каждом. Процесс передачи пациента: врач ↔ терапист Полный документ с пятью этапами лежит отдельно. Здесь — где роль админа в этом процессе. Этап 1. Первичный визит у врача Зафиксировать дату следующего визита пациента к врачу (контрольная точка) Если пациент переносит визит — соответственно перенести и контрольный осмотр Этап 2. Подготовка тераписта Косвенная. Убедиться, что в Alteg.io стоит правильный тип следующей процедуры (по плану врача) и тераписту виден контекст. Этап 3. Приём у тераписта Встреча пациента, обновление статуса «Arrived» в Alteg.io Координация с тераписткой о приходе Обеспечение consent-формы (медсестра заполняет с клиентом) Помощь медсестре в подготовке кабинета Этап 4. Контроль врача Вовремя записать пациента на контрольный визит к врачу (каждые 3–4 процедуры или по плану курса). Этап 5. Завершение курса Это прямая зона админа. Через 3–6 месяцев после завершения курса — благодарственное сообщение и предложение повторного курса Это работа с базой, плановая, фиксируется в карточке клиента Шаблон сообщения — в разделе 5 Координация в клинике: кабинеты, время, задержки Ты тот человек, который знает, где кто находится. В любой момент ты можешь сказать, кто в каком кабинете, с каким клиентом, что делает и когда закончит. Утром пройдись по дню в Alteg.io: какой специалист, какой кабинет, какие процедуры, где нужна анестезия и клиента первой забирает медсестра. В течение дня следи, когда освободится каждый кабинет. Если процедура затягивается, уточни у специалиста новое время окончания, а не угадывай. Если клиент опаздывает , звонишь и узнаёшь, где он. Не ждёшь. Когда клиент пришёл , смени статус в Alteg.io и сразу сообщи специалисту или медсестре. Из кабинета ресепшен не видно. Если врач задерживается Сразу скажи ожидающему клиенту, извинись и назови реальное время, а не «скоро». Предложи чай, кофе или воду. Напиши врачу, уточни время и держи клиента в курсе, пока его не позовут. Клиент, который сидит и ничего не знает, запоминает именно это. Если процедуре нужна анестезия, попроси медсестру забрать клиента и нанести крем, чтобы ожидание не пропадало. Если задержка будет расти, двигай расписание: свяжись со следующими клиентами до того, как они выйдут из дома, и предложи время позже. Не жди, пока они окажутся на ресепшене. Что сказать I'm so sorry, [Name], Dr. Diana is running about 15 minutes behind. Can I bring you a coffee while you wait? I'll let you know as soon as she's ready. Пошагово весь приход клиента и визит описаны в клиентском флоу, этап 1 . Формы согласия General consent В начале дня посмотри расписание. Для каждого нового клиента (и для тех, кто не был у нас последние полгода) подготовь general consent form, чтобы она лежала на ресепшене. Клиент подписывает её при приходе, до визита . Media consent Каждый клиент, который её ещё не подписывал, новый или постоянный. Проверь карточку; если формы нет – попроси подписать. Если клиент отказывается, отметь это в карточке, чтобы больше не спрашивали. На процедуру это не влияет, фото для медкарты всё равно делаются, но нигде не публикуются. Форма media consent → Блогеры и модели Перед любой съёмкой или процедурой по коллаборации подписывается соответствующая форма согласия. Формы лежат в папке с рабочими документами . Согласие на процедуру Готовит медсестра под конкретную процедуру. Твоя задача – проследить, что она подписана до начала. Подписанные формы сканируются и загружаются в карточку клиента (см. раздел 7 ). Деньги: наличные, petty cash и оплаты картой Ты отвечаешь за все деньги, которые проходят через ресепшен: наличные от клиентов, petty cash, оплаты картой и онлайн. Каждая оплата вносится в Alteg.io с правильной суммой и правильным способом оплаты. Сразу после оплаты она проводится в Alteg.io и вносится в файл ACCOUNTING текущего месяца. Не в конце дня. Никто не берёт деньги с ресепшена без твоего контроля. Всё, что даётся бесплатно, по любой причине, оформляется Complimentary Service Form и проводится со скидкой 100%. Отчёт в конце дня в финансовую группу описан в разделе 7 . На каждый расход из petty cash есть чек, в тот же день. Наличные, petty cash и оплаты картой сверяются с Alteg.io в конце каждого дня. Суммы считаются в системе или на калькуляторе, не в уме, и перепроверяются до оплаты. Расхождения – твоя ответственность Любая недостача в наличных или petty cash и любая сумма, которую недобрали с клиента, покрывается тобой в соответствии с политикой клиники и трудовым законодательством ОАЭ. Если ты недобрала с клиента больше 200 AED , можно связаться с ним, извиниться и аккуратно попросить доплатить разницу. Так, чтобы не потерять отношения: лояльность клиента важнее суммы. Если клиент не доплачивает, разницу покрываешь ты. Сообщение клиенту Hi [Name], I hope you're feeling great after your visit. I've just noticed I made a mistake with your bill: [treatment] was charged at [amount] instead of [amount], so [difference] AED was missed. I'm really sorry about that. Would it be easier to settle it by payment link, or at your next visit? Товар, поставки и инвойсы Когда приходит поставка Ты принимаешь любую поставку продуктов и расходников, которая приходит в клинику. Сверяешь с заказом и инвойсом. В тот же день регистрируешь её в Alteg.io. Берёшь инвойс и загружаешь его в папку текущего месяца в финансовой папке . Вносишь в трекер инвойсов и следишь, что оплачено, а что нет. Оплата инвойсов Инвойсы оплачивает доктор Диана как владелица. Это единственный немедицинский вопрос, который идёт к ней. Твоя задача – следить: присылать ей инвойсы к оплате и отмечать оплаченные. Инвентаризация витрины – два раза в месяц Пересчитай все продукты на витрине и проверь сроки годности. Полный отчёт отправь Clinic Manager и финансисту. Отдельно отправь Clinic Manager список позиций с низким остатком для проверки и заказа. Заказы согласует Clinic Manager. Контакты поставщиков – в справочнике поставщиков в папке с рабочими документами . СОП по депозитам (Reservation SOP) Полный живой документ: Открыть СОП по бронированиям и депозитам → Здесь — ключевые правила, которые админ должна помнить наизусть. Reservation fee 210 AED – кто платит Проблемная история (no-show за 3 месяца, 2+ поздние отмены, 3+ отмены подряд, отметка в карточке, нет визитов 6 месяцев) – fee обязателен, к любому специалисту Новый клиент, чистая история: к терапевту – без fee; к Диане – fee только если это первая запись её дня; в середине дня или последним – без fee. Без fee всегда отправляешь сообщение о политике отмен Постоянный клиент, 3+ визита, чистая история – без fee. Полное дерево решений – на странице про запись Если назначено несколько процедур / слотов в один курс — депозит 210 за каждый слот (3 процедуры = 630 AED) Оплата через Stripe-ссылку, которая отправляется клиенту сразу после согласования слота Окно оплаты При записи Слот резервируется в Alteg.io сразу В течение 24 часов Депозит должен быть оплачен клиентом Следующий день в 12:00 Проверка оплаты. Если не оплачено — ремайндер До 18:00 того же дня Если депозит так и не оплачен — запись удаляется, слот освобождается Правило 24 часов (отмена / перенос) Изменения более чем за 24 часа до визита — депозит сохраняется автоматически на следующую запись Изменения менее чем за 24 часа — депозит сгорает по политике Исключение на первый раз: депозит сохраняется на 3 месяца (см. раздел 4 ) Трекер депозитов Отдельный файл (Cosmo_Di_Deposit_Tracker.xlsx). Колонки: Date / Client / Service / Amount / Status / Used Against / Notes. Для отмен и переносов отдельно — фиксируешь каждый случай в Трекере отмен и переносов → Статусы: Active депозит оплачен, запись актуальна Used депозит использован на проведённую процедуру Forfeited депозит сгорел (отмена менее 24 часов, no-show) Refunded депозит возвращён (исключительные случаи, только с одобрения руководства) Обновление трекера — ежедневная задача (закрытие смены) + понедельник как полная сверка (см. раздел 7 ).

en: 07 — Rhythm Day & week structure How time is structured so that everything important fits and nothing critical falls through. Working day structure You work 5 days a week, 8 hours a day plus a 30-minute lunch break. Your day always starts at 9:50 , 10 minutes before the clinic opens, and ends at about 18:20 , once the last client has left and the day is closed. The current working days are in Alteg.io. Do it the moment it happens Nothing waits until later, because later is when things get forgotten. The client arrives – you change the status in Alteg.io. The client pays – you put the payment through in Alteg.io immediately and add it to the day's report. A booking is created or changed – the confirmation goes out straight away. 9:50 – Opening (always, before the clinic opens) Turn on the lights and the computer; turn on the music (relax / lounge via YouTube → Bluetooth player in Diana's room) and check that it is actually playing; check the AC in every room Check reception — cleanliness, order, water / tea / coffee, supplies Check change money Open Alteg.io, Revenelle, WhatsApp, Instagram Send the morning reminders from Revenelle – all appointment reminders and confirmation requests it shows Go through today's schedule: who is in which room, which treatments need numbing. Prepare the general consent form for every new client and note who still has to sign media consent ( Section 6 ) 10:00–12:00 — Morning communication block (top priority) The hard rule The first 1–2 hours of the day are for replying to every message that came in overnight and the evening before. Nothing else happens in this window — no stock, no operational tasks, no reports, no errands. The only acceptable interruption is meeting a client who has arrived. Every message gets a reply before you move on to the rest of the day. Channels handled in this block: WhatsApp Instagram Direct Missed calls Full replies per Section 4 logic: read history → determine request type → answer on substance → lead to booking. For first messages from ads, follow the structured first-reply logic in Section 4 . Through the day — control confirmations Reminders go out from Revenelle in the morning; confirmations of new, moved or cancelled bookings go out straight away. You don't monitor replies all day. Two check-points: 14:00 – follow up everyone who didn't reply to the reminder; 17:00 – call anyone still silent, close every tomorrow status before you leave (full protocol in Section 3 ). 12:00–18:00 — Live work + flexible tasks Through the rest of the day, the following run in parallel: Incoming messages — reply within 15 minutes (priority all day) Arriving clients — meet by Section 3 standards (stand, by name, eye contact, lead, drinks, inform the specialist) Filling consent forms with clients (tablet, with the nurse) Room preparation support Flexible-window tasks, completed in pauses between live work: Sleeping base — 10 messages a day ( Section 4.9 ). Filter Alteg.io by last-visit age (60+/90+/180+). Read each card, write a personal message, log replies in cards. Follow-up 3 days after visit — message to all clients who had a procedure 3 days ago. If they didn't leave a Google review at the clinic — gentle request to leave one. At client exit — KPI 90% next-visit booking + Google review request with a small gift Revenelle, every day: send the repeat-visit follow-ups it has prepared, birthday greetings, and work the sleeping base; add every new lead and keep lead statuses up to date ( Section 9 ) YOLO for DHA — entering completed procedures (duplicates info from Alteg.io). This is regulatory, not "if I have time" Scanning consent forms after procedures and uploading PDFs to Alteg.io → client card → Files Checking client cards in Alteg.io — are all today's patients' cards filled in by the doctor? If not — follow up with the doctor to upload or send for upload Petty cash recording Collecting receipts and invoices (for the accountant) Billing for each completed procedure Deposit tracker update Supplier coordination (only through the admin; orders approved by the Clinic Manager) Deliveries : receive, register in Alteg.io, upload the invoice to the finance folder, add it to the invoices tracker Running the floor : know who is in which room and when they finish; if someone is running late, keep the waiting client informed and move the schedule if needed Confirmation control : two check-points — 14:00 follow-up to non-responders, 17:00 calls + close statuses (per Section 3 ) After the last client – Closing (about 18:20) See off the last client. Check that every booking of the day in Alteg.io is correct and closed (status, payment), and that every client is entered in YOLO. Final check: all tomorrow's bookings confirmed; if not, call. By closing time the status must be clear (see Section 3 ). Count the cash, check the card payments, print the X/Z report. Make sure every payment (with the client's name) and every cash expense (with invoice number or purpose) is in the current month's ACCOUNTING file in the finance folder. Update the deposit tracker. Send the day's report to the WhatsApp group COSMO DI Financial management (see below). Reception ready for tomorrow; lights, music and AC off. Lock the clinic with your key. The day's report To the group COSMO DI Financial management , every working day: a photo of the X/Z report and of every card slip, with the client's name written on each slip; the summary below, with the link to the current month's ACCOUNTING file. Date: [DD/MM/YYYY] Card payments: [amount] Bank transfer: [amount] Payment link: [amount] Cash sales: [amount] Tips: [amount] Cash on Hand: [amount] Vouchers: [amount] Petty cash: [amount] Receptionist: [your name] [link to the current month's ACCOUNTING file] Working week structure Every day Day structure as above — the same for every working day. Monday (in addition) Cancellations and reschedules per SOP: review last week's cancellations, work with clients who cancelled and didn't reschedule, update deposit tracker statuses (Used / Forfeited / Refunded) Invoices: check the invoices tracker for what is unpaid and due, and send Dr. Diana the list for payment Twice a month Showcase inventory: count the products and check expiry dates. Send the full report to the Clinic Manager and the financier, and a separate list of low-stock items to the Clinic Manager to check and order ( Section 6 ) Saturday (in addition) Attendance log update in Excel Weekly KPI summary (see Section 8 — fill in the Weekly KPI Tracker) Create the next week's tab in Daily Admin Tasks — copy the template, update dates, check for monthly tasks falling in that week Monthly Help with monthly inventory (with the whole team) Price sync with the Clinic Manager (update prices and promos in Alteg.io) Monthly KPI summary for the Clinic Manager (once at the end of the month) Ongoing (background, no fixed time) Coordination with the doctor, the aesthetician, the nurse and the Clinic Manager Reception cleanliness and order Confidentiality of client data Supplier coordination — only through the admin, not directly through the doctors Daily Admin Tasks file Live file: Open the Daily Admin Tasks tracker → Below is the structure. A Google Sheets file (or Excel) with several tabs: Tab 1: "Week of [date]" The working-week template. On the left — task list grouped by blocks. On the right — 7 columns (Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun). Weekend columns (Thu, Sun) are greyed out for all rows. Each cell in working columns is filled by status: White — not started Grey — in progress Green — done Red — not done Task grouping in the sheet Mirrors the day structure above: Opening · Morning communication block · Confirmation control · Sleeping base · Follow-up and Google reviews · Live client work · Operational tasks · Closing · Weekly extras (filled in for the relevant day) · One-off / extra tasks (free rows). Tab 2: Archive (past weeks) Each past week stays as a tab — old tab with the finished week remains in the file, a new one is created every Saturday for the upcoming week. Tab 3: Weekly KPI Tracker Detail — in Section 8 . Bottom of each weekly tab — "Week totals" Next-visit bookings: X of Y clients (Z%) Cancellations: X of Y bookings (Z%) Google reviews: X new reviews / Y procedures (Z%) Sleeping base touches: X messages / Y replies / Z bookings These numbers are filled in on Saturday at week close.
ru: 07 — Ритм День и неделя Структура времени, чтобы успевать всё важное и не упускать ничего критичного. Структура рабочего дня Ты работаешь 5 дней в неделю, 8 часов плюс 30 минут обед. Твой день всегда начинается в 9:50 , за 10 минут до открытия клиники, и заканчивается примерно в 18:20 , когда ушёл последний клиент и день закрыт. Актуальные рабочие дни – в Alteg.io. Делай сразу, как только это произошло Ничего не откладывается на потом, потому что потом это забывается. Клиент пришёл – меняешь статус в Alteg.io. Клиент оплатил – сразу проводишь оплату в Alteg.io и вносишь в отчёт дня. Запись создана или изменена – подтверждение уходит сразу. 9:50 – Открытие (всегда, до открытия клиники) Включить свет и компьютер; включить музыку (relax / lounge через YouTube → Bluetooth-плеер в кабинете Дианы) и проверить, что она реально играет; проверить кондиционеры во всех кабинетах Проверить ресепшен — чистота, порядок, вода / кофе / чай, расходники Проверить наличие сдачи (change money) Открыть Alteg.io, Revenelle, WhatsApp, Instagram Отправить утренние напоминания из Revenelle – все напоминания о записях и запросы на подтверждение, которые он показывает Пройтись по расписанию дня: кто в каком кабинете, каким процедурам нужна анестезия. Подготовить general consent form для каждого нового клиента и отметить, кому ещё нужно подписать media consent ( раздел 6 ) 10:00–12:00 — Утренний блок коммуникации (главный приоритет) Железное правило Первые 1–2 часа рабочего дня — это ответы на все сообщения, накопившиеся со вчерашнего вечера и ночи. В это время не происходит ничего другого: ни склад, ни операционные задачи, ни отчёты, ни поручения. Единственное допустимое прерывание — встретить пришедшего клиента. Каждое сообщение получает ответ до того, как ты переходишь к остальным задачам дня. Каналы, которые разбираешь в этом блоке: WhatsApp Instagram Direct Пропущенные звонки Развёрнутые ответы по логике раздела 4: читаешь историю → определяешь тип запроса → отвечаешь по сути → ведёшь к записи. Для первых сообщений с рекламы — по структуре первого ответа из раздела 4 . В течение дня — контроль подтверждений Напоминания уходят из Revenelle утром, подтверждения новых, перенесённых и отменённых записей – сразу. Ответы весь день не мониторишь. Две сверки: 14:00 – follow-up всем, кто не ответил на напоминание; 17:00 – звонок тем, кто всё ещё молчит, закрыть все статусы на завтра перед уходом (полный протокол в разделе 3 ). 12:00–18:00 — Работа в моменте + гибкие задачи Параллельно весь день идёт: Входящие сообщения — ответ в течение 15 минут (приоритет весь день) Приходящие клиенты — встреча по стандартам раздела 3 (встать, по имени, eye contact, проводить, напитки, сообщить врачу/тераписту) Заполнение consent-форм с клиентами (планшет, с медсестрой) Подготовка кабинетов Гибкие задачи, выполняются в паузах между работой в моменте: Спящая база — 10 сообщений в день ( раздел 4.9 ). Фильтр Alteg.io по давности (60+/90+/180+). Читаешь карточку, пишешь индивидуальное сообщение, фиксируешь ответы в карточках. Follow-up через 3 дня — сообщение всем клиентам, которые были 3 дня назад. Если не оставили Google-отзыв в клинике — мягкая просьба оставить. en: 08 — Performance KPI & measurement Four numbers that define how your work is evaluated. Plus the weekly tracker that keeps them visible. Four administrator KPIs These are the metrics by which your work is evaluated. Not "greets clients well" or "answers messages well" — that's too abstract. Only concrete numbers. 90% Next-visit booking ≤5% Cancellations 30% Google reviews 10/day Sleeping base touches KPI 1. Next-visit booking — 90% What we count Of all clients who exit the clinic after a procedure, 90% should leave with a next-visit booking. Why This is the main retention lever. A client who left without a next booking is unlikely to come back. A client with a booking did come back. Where we look Alteg.io — completed procedures report for the period + checking each client's card for a next booking. When we count Weekly (Saturday, when filling the Weekly KPI Tracker). Formula (clients with next-visit booking / total clients who completed a procedure that week) × 100% KPI 2. Cancellation rate — no more than 5% What we count What percentage of bookings were cancelled. Why Current cancellation level is 26% — a critical revenue leak. Target: 5% via deposits + confirmation work + retention attempts during cancellation. What counts as a cancellation A booking that didn't take place. If the deposit was forfeited (per policy) — still a cancellation, just a "protected" one. Where we look Alteg.io — status "Cancelled" in bookings. Formula (cancelled bookings / total bookings that week) × 100% KPI 3. Google reviews — 30% of clients What we count What percentage of clients who completed a procedure left a Google review. Why Google reviews are the main organic growth channel for a premium clinic in Dubai. Every review reduces the cost of acquiring new clients. Where we look Google My Business (Cosmo Di Aesthetic Clinic) — count of new reviews for the period. Formula (new reviews that week / clients who completed a procedure that week) × 100% KPI 4. Sleeping base conversion — baseline first What we count Of the clients we messaged from the sleeping base in a week, how many returned with a booking. Why The sleeping base is an underused resource. We don't know yet what conversion is possible. First 1–2 months — measure the baseline, then set a concrete target. Where we look In the client card in Alteg.io there should be a note "Sleeping base contact [date]" → check whether a booking appeared after the contact. Work norm 10 messages a day from the sleeping base (60+/90+/180+) Formula (sleeping clients who booked after our contact / sleeping-base messages sent that week) × 100% Weekly KPI Tracker Live file: Open the Daily Admin Tasks tracker → The Weekly KPI Tracker is a separate tab inside the same file. Table structure: Week Next-visit bookings % Cancellations % Google reviews % Sleeping sent Sleeping booked % Week 1 X / Y Z% A / B C% D E% 60 F G% Week 2 … … … … … … … … … When filled in Saturday evening, as part of closing the week. Who reviews Tatiana + Diana — short monthly review. Actions based on KPI results If a KPI is below target Next-visit booking below 90%: analyse — on which procedures are clients most often leaving without a booking? What words aren't working at exit? Cancellations above 5%: analyse — is there a pattern? Which client categories cancel most often? Google reviews below 30%: analyse — am I forgetting to ask? Are gifts in stock? Is the follow-up request going out? Escalation If a KPI is below target for three weeks in a row — discussion with Tatiana. Not punishment, but a review of causes and approach correction.
ru: 08 — Эффективность KPI и измерение Четыре цифры, по которым оценивается твоя работа. Плюс еженедельный трекер, чтобы они всегда были видны. Четыре KPI администратора Это метрики, по которым оценивается работа админа. Не «правильно встречает клиентов» и «хорошо отвечает на сообщения» — это слишком абстрактно. Только конкретные цифры. 90% Запись на следующий визит ≤5% Отмены 30% Google-отзывы 10/day Спящая база (касаний) KPI 1. Запись на следующий визит — 90% Что считаем Из всех клиентов, которые выходят из клиники после процедуры, 90% должны иметь запись на следующий визит. Зачем Это главный рычаг удержания. Клиент, который ушёл без следующей записи, с большой вероятностью не вернётся. Клиент с записью — вернулся. Где смотрим Alteg.io — отчёт о проведённых процедурах за период + проверка карточки каждого клиента на следующую запись. Когда считаем Еженедельно (суббота, при заполнении Weekly KPI Tracker). Формула (количество клиентов с записью на следующий визит / количество клиентов, прошедших процедуру за неделю) × 100% KPI 2. Процент отмен — не более 5% Что считаем Какой процент записей был отменён. Зачем Текущий уровень отмен — 26%. Это критическая потеря выручки. Цель — снизить до 5% через предоплату + работу с подтверждениями + удержание при попытке отмены. Что считается отменой Запись, которая не состоялась. Если депозит сгорел (по политике) — это тоже отмена, но «защищённая». Где смотрим Alteg.io — статус «Cancelled» в записях. Формула (количество отменённых записей / общее количество записей за неделю) × 100% KPI 3. Google-отзывы — 30% клиентов Что считаем Какой процент клиентов, прошедших процедуру, оставил Google-отзыв. Зачем Google-отзывы — главный канал органического роста премиум-клиники в Дубае. Каждый отзыв снижает стоимость привлечения нового клиента. Где смотрим Google My Business (Cosmo Di Aesthetic Clinic) — количество новых отзывов за период. Формула (количество новых отзывов за неделю / количество клиентов, прошедших процедуру за неделю) × 100% KPI 4. Конверсия спящей базы — сначала baseline Что считаем Сколько из клиентов, кому отправили сообщение по спящей базе за неделю, вернулись с записью. Зачем Спящая база — недооценённый ресурс. Сейчас непонятно, какая конверсия возможна. Первые 1–2 месяца замеряем baseline, потом ставим конкретный таргет. Где смотрим В карточке клиента в Alteg.io должна быть пометка «Sleeping base contact [date]» → проверяем, появилась ли у него запись после контакта. Норма работы 10 сообщений в день из спящей базы (60+/90+/180+) Формула (количество спящих, кто записался после нашего контакта / количество отправленных сообщений по спящей базе за неделю) × 100% Weekly KPI Tracker Живой файл: Открыть Daily Admin Tasks → Weekly KPI Tracker — отдельная вкладка внутри этого же файла. Структура таблицы: Неделя Записи на след. визит % Отмены % Google reviews % Спящая: отправлено Спящая: записалось % Week 1 X / Y Z% A / B C% D E% 60 F G% Week 2 … … … … … … … … … Когда заполняется Суббота вечером, как часть закрытия рабочей недели. Кто проверяет Татьяна + Диана — раз в месяц короткий обзор. Действия по результатам KPI Если KPI ниже целевого Запись на следующий ниже 90%: анализируешь — на каких процедурах чаще всего клиенты уходят без записи? Какие слова не работают при выходе клиента? Отмены выше 5%: анализируешь — есть ли паттерн? Какие категории клиентов чаще всего отменяют? Google-отзывы ниже 30%: анализируешь — не забываешь ли просить? Подарки в наличии? Просьба в follow-up уходит? Эскалация Если три недели подряд один из KPI ниже целевого — обсуждение с Татьяной. Не наказание, а разбор причин и корректировка подхода.

en: 09 — Tools Tools & escalation Systems you use every day, and the people to go to when something is beyond your zone. Alteg.io — main tool Alteg.io (Altegio) is the clinic management system. It is where clients live, where bookings live, where procedure history, payments, and reports live. What the admin does in Alteg.io daily Creating and maintaining bookings Create bookings with the correct procedure type (see Section 4 table ) In the booking comment — note the procedure type + "doctor to confirm" tag when needed Reserve the slot at the moment the client agrees Update statuses: Booked → Arrived → Completed / Cancelled / No-show Straight away, not later: the status changes the moment the client arrives, and a payment is put through the moment the client pays On the client's first visit , set the tag for where they came from (Instagram, Google, referral, walk-in and so on) Packages and stock Every package sold is set up as a membership (Memberships), ready-made or individual ( Section 10 ) Every delivery of products and consumables is registered in Alteg.io the day it arrives Maintaining the client card On first contact — create a card if there isn't one Personal info: name, phone, email, date of birth, source (Instagram / Google / referral) Structured comments: PERSONAL / COMMUNICATION / PREFERENCES ( Section 3 ) Labels: VIP / Diana Only / Sensitive / Less than 3 visits ( Section 3 ) Files: uploading scanned consent forms (PDF) Filtering and base work Sleeping base: filter by last-visit date (60+/90+/180+ days) Cancellations per period: filter by status "Cancelled" Upcoming bookings: schedule for tomorrow / this week Finance Client billing after procedures (cash / card / bank transfer) Loyalty bonus: accrues on the full transaction amount, procedures and products together ( Section 2 ) Petty cash recording Step-by-step screenshots and concrete UI walk-throughs for Alteg.io will be added separately (after Tatiana provides the screenshots). For now — general instructions only. Revenelle An AI add-on to Alteg.io that helps you with client communication. Alteg.io stays the main CRM. Revenelle is there to help you write to clients on time and not miss anyone. What you do in Revenelle Reminders and confirmations. Revenelle shows every message that needs to go out: reminders about upcoming appointments, confirmation requests, and notices that a booking was created, changed or cancelled. Reminders are sent every morning; everything else the moment it happens. Repeat-visit follow-ups. The system works out who is due to come back and prepares the message. You send them every day. Client history. Everything about a client in one place, for example if someone is travelling and you need to see where things stand. Every lead goes in. Called, walked in, wrote on any messenger, came by recommendation – every lead is entered in Revenelle and its status is kept up to date. (In Alteg.io, the source tag is set on the day of the first visit.) Birthdays, offers and the sleeping base. Birthday greetings, offer mailings and work with the sleeping base all go out from Revenelle. Treatment plans. The client's treatment plan is visible here, and you can send it to the client from Revenelle. Send it straight away Revenelle prepares the messages, but it doesn't send them for you. A reminder that goes out late or not at all is how no-shows and lost clients happen. Video instruction – coming soon A step-by-step screen recording of working in Revenelle will be added here. WhatsApp Business Channel Main channel for client communication. What the admin does Reply to all incoming within 15 minutes during working hours Sends reminders and confirmations from Revenelle and follows up non-responders Text only – never voice messages Run follow-up 3 days after visit Work the sleeping base Send Stripe links for deposits Chat organisation Use Labels to classify conversations: "New inquiry", "Booking", "Sleeping base", "Follow-up", "VIP" — lets you find conversations quickly and never lose context Replies in English; in Russian only if you speak it and the client writes in Russian ( Section 3 ). Text only, no voice messages Instagram Direct Channel Incoming inquiries from people who saw an ad or content. What the admin does Reply to incoming within 15 minutes during working hours Main goal — move the conversation from Instagram to WhatsApp (faster, easier for booking, can send the Stripe link) Transfer script: For easier communication and to send you the booking confirmation, may I continue the conversation on WhatsApp? Our number is +971 56 423 5151. YOLO — DHA system Channel The Dubai Health Authority regulatory system. What the admin does After every procedure — enter the client and the procedure into YOLO (duplicates the info from Alteg.io) This is required for DHA compliance Important This is a regulatory requirement, not "when we have time" Non-compliance leads to fines and problems with the clinic licence In case of a DHA inspection — call Ahmed Al Baluki immediately, +971 54 276 9773 (see escalation below) Daily Admin Tasks (Excel / Google Sheets) Channel Your daily working instrument. Structure "Week of [date]" tab — the current working week with tasks and statuses Archive of past weeks — each week as a separate tab "Weekly KPI Tracker" — filled in on Saturdays What the admin does During the day — mark task statuses (cell fill colour) On Saturday — fill in the KPI tracker + create the next week's tab Stripe — deposits Channel Client deposit payment. What the admin does On booking — send the client a Stripe link for 210 AED Check payment status next day at 12:00 If not paid — reminder If not paid by 18:00 — delete the booking Email — admin@cosmo-di.com For rare cases — formal requests, documents, communication with suppliers. Almost no client communication happens here. Check email once a day (during the morning communication block). Escalation — to whom and when Medical concerns / complaints (skin reaction, pain) You lead the case. The treating specialist or the nurse assesses, Dr. Diana if needed. Possible complication – immediately ( Section 12 ). Service complaints You lead the case, the Clinic Manager decides on compensation Discount requests, non-standard offers, financial exceptions Within your discount limits – you decide ( Section 10 ). Above them and anything non-standard – Clinic Manager Conflicts with colleagues or clients Clinic Manager Technical problems You contact the relevant service support yourself (Alteg.io, WhatsApp Business, office IT). If it can't be resolved — the Clinic Manager. DHA inspection Immediately: Ahmed Al Baluki, +971 54 276 9773. In parallel — the Clinic Manager (and the doctor if needed). Confidentiality breach Clinic Manager, immediately Suppliers Orders – approved by the Clinic Manager. Invoice payments – Dr. Diana as owner; you keep track of them Setting VIP or Diana Only labels Only with the Clinic Manager's approval Admin, schedule, communication Clinic Manager. Dr. Diana is asked strictly medical questions only
